problem: Seven persistent retrieval misses have answer-bearing gold documents in the frozen corpus, but identical generated queries place no gold document in the full-document BM25 top-20 and only two cases in the top-100.
simplest_baseline: Keep one Lucene BM25 record per complete source document and the exact recorded trial-1 generated queries; do not add query calls, reranking, or agents.
hypothesis: Splitting every source document into deterministic 256-token passages with 64-token overlap and repeated bounded frontmatter will place a gold parent document in the collapsed top-20 for at least four of the seven diagnosed cases under the identical queries.
changed_mechanisms: full-document BM25 representation replaced by deterministic overlapping passage BM25 representation
anti_claim: This outcome-selected offline screen cannot establish end-to-end accuracy, general retrieval improvement, official benchmark performance, or model capability improvement.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Delegating the same low-recall index repeats the retrieval miss; passage representation is the smaller causal intervention.
Changing orchestration or compression cannot help before the answer-bearing source enters the candidate pool.
The frozen queries already rank six gold documents only at depth 47 to 736; another crawler role is less direct than testing document granularity.
Search-graph fan-out is justified by omitted independent branches, not by a measured full-document ranking representation failure.

frozen_controls: same seven outcome-selected persistent retrieval misses
same trial-1 recorded successful generated queries
same 100195 source documents and byte-frozen Lucene index
256 whitespace tokens per passage with 64-token overlap
200 internal passage hits collapsed to at most 20 unique source documents
zero provider, online search, and Judge calls
next_action: Implement and unit-test the frozen passage export and collapsed-document retrieval contract, build the complete local index, then apply the registered Recall@20 and index-completeness gates without changing parameters.
claim_boundary: The seven cases are posthoc and gold-aware. Passing only authorizes a fresh development comparison under fixed model, search calls, Token budget, cost budget, and Judge; failure freezes the passage branch.
